verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API with an endpoint list and an open-source Python module of scripts and templates. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference where examples can be run in place, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. The Python example module is a developer building block, adjacent to the story rather than the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can also access an open-source Python module that includes scripts and templates
You can use these examples to build your own integrations or automate tasks.
